## Summary

Describe the user-visible and operational change.

## Verification

- [ ] Typecheck
- [ ] Unit/integration tests
- [ ] Migration checks, when applicable
- [ ] Authorization and cross-tenant tests, when applicable
- [ ] Browser/accessibility tests, when applicable
- [ ] No secrets or customer data added

## Infrastructure and security

List new migrations, bindings, secret **names** (never values), provider
callbacks, permission changes, cost implications, and rollback steps.

## Evidence and limitations

Link reproducible evidence and identify anything not verified.
